strategy.thesis: Private investment arm of Hong Kong billionaire Li Ka-shing, led by Solina Chau; deploys his personal capital globally into deep science and technology, with a documented sub-thesis in biotech (genetic medicine, cell therapy, microbiome, regenerative medicine, protein engineering) and healthcare technology (AI-driven diagnostics, digital health platforms, telehealth) alongside its broader deep-tech portfolio.

people.name: Solina Chau
people.background: Long-time lead of Li Ka-shing's personal investment portfolio

summary.en: Horizons Ventures is the Hong Kong-based private investment office of billionaire Li Ka-shing (led by Solina Chau), deploying his personal capital globally into deep-tech and biotech, including genetic medicine, cell therapy, regenerative medicine, and AI-driven digital health.
summary.local: 維港投資是香港富豪李嘉誠的私人投資機構，由周凱旋主導，在全球投資深科技與生物科技，涵蓋基因醫學、細胞治療、再生醫學及人工智能驅動的數位健康。

strategy.thesis: Venture arm of the Lee Kum Kee Group, the 137-year-old Hong Kong sauce and health-products conglomerate; invests seed-to-growth in startups across Food, Health, Trust and Climate Change, applying a 'Happiness Return' framework alongside financial return, with Health as one of its four core investment pillars.

summary.en: Happiness Capital is the Hong Kong-based global venture capital arm of the Lee Kum Kee family's LKK Health Products Group, founded in 2017, investing seed-to-growth in startups across Food, Health, Trust and Climate Change, with Health as one of its four core pillars.
summary.local: 幸福資本是李錦記家族旗下李錦記健康產品集團於2017年成立的全球創投機構，投資聚焦食品、健康、信任及氣候變化四大領域，「健康」為其核心投資支柱之一。

strategy.thesis: Hong Kong family office of Alibaba co-founder Joe Tsai, managing a multi-billion-dollar diversified portfolio (hedge funds, private equity, real estate, sports, fintech) that includes direct venture stakes in Chinese biopharma drug developers.

summary.en: Blue Pool Capital is the Hong Kong family office of Alibaba co-founder Joe Tsai, founded in 2015; alongside its core tech, fintech and sports holdings it has made direct venture investments in Chinese biopharma companies including Hua Medicine and Brii Biosciences.
summary.local: 藍池資本是阿里巴巴聯合創辦人蔡崇信於2015年在香港設立的家族辦公室，除科技、金融科技及體育產業投資外，亦直接投資華領醫藥、騰盛博藥等中國生物醫藥企業。

strategy.thesis: Single family office of Hong Kong real-estate billionaire Cai Kui, investing family wealth across asset classes (VC, PE, hedge funds, real estate); healthcare and biotech are named among its target industries alongside hospitality, technology and media.

summary.en: Junson Capital is the Hong Kong single family office of billionaire Cai Kui, founded in 2013; it lists healthcare and biotech among its target industries and has made direct investments such as wireless-power robotics firm WiBiotic.
summary.local: 俊思集團是香港億萬富豪蔡奎於2013年設立的家族辦公室，將醫療健康及生物科技列為目標投資產業之一，並曾直接投資無線充電機器人公司WiBiotic等。

strategy.thesis: Investment vehicle of New World Development scion Adrian Cheng (Cheng family), backing consumer, lifestyle, tech and 'transformative industries' bets; healthcare recurs as a theme via genomic-diagnostics unicorn Prenetics (which Cheng SPAC'd and remains a cornerstone investor in) and a direct stake in a medical-equipment leasing firm.

summary.en: C Capital (formerly C Ventures) is the Hong Kong investment vehicle of New World Development scion Adrian Cheng, founded in 2017; alongside lifestyle and tech bets it has repeatedly backed healthcare, most notably as SPAC sponsor and cornerstone investor in genomic/diagnostic testing unicorn Prenetics, plus a direct stake in a medical-equipment leasing firm.
summary.local: C Capital（前稱 C Ventures）是新世界發展第三代鄭志剛於2017年成立的投資機構，除時尚生活及科技投資外，亦多次投資醫療健康領域，包括作為SPAC發起人及基石投資者促成基因檢測獨角獸Prenetics上市，並直接投資醫療設備租賃公司。

sources.supports: Founder, Prenetics SPAC deal, healthcare focus

Adrian Cheng lists C Capital unit on the Swiss bourse with US$700 million of assets
sources.quote: C Capital, founded in 2017, was listed on the SIX Swiss exchange with US$700 million of assets under management

verification_notes: Predominantly a diversified lifestyle/consumer/tech investment vehicle for the Cheng family; healthcare/biomedical exposure is real but secondary (Prenetics genomic diagnostics IPO, one medical-equipment leasing stake) rather than a dedicated life-science thesis. The firm has also taken on some external capital via a SIX Swiss Exchange-listed vehicle, blurring the line between family office and institutional investor — included here as a family-founded/controlled office with a verifiable biomedical nexus.
